items.title: Israel intensifies Gaza strikes and reaffirms it will not withdraw before full Hamas disarmament
items.description: After Donald Trump announced a plan on July 30 calling for the withdrawal of Israeli troops from the Palestinian enclave alongside Hamas's arsenal, Gaza experienced one of its deadliest days in recent weeks on August 2.

items.title: At Least 5 Killed in Ukraine’s Latest Drone Attacks Against Wildberries
items.description: Moscow region authorities said another 10 people were injured in an overnight strike on a warehouse in the city of Chekov.

items.title: Iran war live: Qatar says diplomatic efforts ongoing, vessel hit in Hormuz
items.description: US president says talks with Iran are under way, warning the negotiations are Tehran's 'last chance' to secure a deal.

items.title: Zelensky, 'sanzioni contro le imprese dell'industria della difesa russa'
Zelensky Says Ukraine Will Push to End Russia’s War Before Winter
items.description: Zelensky said Ukraine will work to create enough pressure to force Russia toward peace before winter, combining diplomacy, sanctions and medium- and long-range strikes. He cautioned that the timing cannot be guaranteed and accused Putin of preparing to prolong the war.

items.title: Israel violates Lebanese airspace, kills over two dozen in Gaza in weekend strikes
items.description: Israeli forces reportedly killed more than two dozen Palestinians in Gaza and violated Lebanese airspace more than 100 times over the weekend despite ongoing ceasefire agreements, UN agencies and peacekeepers said on Monday.

items.title: Rare photos of ex-Myanmar leader Aung San Suu Kyi give her family hope
items.description: Kim Aris, son of Aung San Suu Kyi, told NPR that photographs of his mother meeting a foreign official gave him "a reason to hope" for the first time since the military coup that ousted her in 2021.

items.title: Trump now says he will halt Iran strikes, having reached outline to end war
items.description: President Donald Trump says he'll hold off on strikes he had threatened on against Iran, claiming allies reached the outline of a deal to end the war.

items.title: Poland: Prime Minister Tusk defies anti-Ukrainian violence
items.description: Anti-Ukrainian sentiment in Poland is on the rise, with numerous attacks against refugees from the war in Ukraine. Prime Minister Donald Tusk has spoken out against the violence and warned of the danger from Russia.

items.title: At Least 3 Killed, 21 Wounded In Moscow Restaurant Bombing, Russian Authorities Say
items.description: Russian authorities said on August 2 that an improvised explosive device was detonated at a restaurant in central Moscow, killing three people and wounding 21 others, as investigators worked to determine who was behind the bombing.
